name: prestamos-pro
description: Suite de escritorio para administrar préstamos, clientes y finanzas
author: Préstamos Pro

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.dist: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run package
scripts.release: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish always
